one_line_description: Klaviyo is a marketing and analytics platform that provides an API for developers to integrate with their services.
auth_notes: Klaviyo uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication. It requires creating an app in Klaviyo and obtaining a client ID and client secret.
gate_detail: Klaviyo offers a free trial for developers to test the API.

evidence.quote_snippet: On March 31, 2025, Klaviyo started blocking all OAuth token traffic (oauth/token and oauth/revoke) routed through www.klaviyo.com. Ensure that your integration routes token traffic to https://a.klaviyo.com/oauth/token or https://a.klaviyo.com/oauth/revoke to avoid breakages.

All /api endpoints use API private keys to authenticate requests. If you do not use an API key for your requests, or if you use a key from the wrong account, your call will return an error. A 400 error indicates an invalid or missing API key.
Klaviyo pricing ranges from $0 for the free plan to $25 for the Marketing plan, depending on the number of active profiles and other features.
